newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium falls, tracking LME in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium falls, tracking LME in thin trade.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed mostly lower on Tuesday in quiet trade, reflecting the LME's falls on Friday and the yen's renewed advance, traders said.
The Tokyo aluminium futures market was closed on Monday for a national holiday.
Prices ranged from 0.9 yen higher to 1.5 yen lower, with benchmark April 1998 losing 1.0 yen to close at 208.0 yen per kg.
The day's trade volume was 2,043 lots, the second smallest on record after 1,978 lots on April 18.
"Prices will climb again as long as the LME remains firm," said one trader, adding trade volume might also rise if prices showed larger fluctuations.
